answer: One enforceable rule: lock a compute bond for six epochs and slash it the moment two answers fingerprint-match. A single reused nonce reveals every sibling at once. Because it works by making the twenty-first clone cost more than the first twenty combined, the cluster is rate-limited until independent attestation arrives. The network ties the delta to sunk effort, uses the vault as an corroborating signal, then requires a oasis before any payout.
